subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Which additive Gateway lifetime contract and already-effecting response semantics should replace the server-only timer?
rationale: Existing clients support default, custom, unbounded, and explicit-abort lifetimes that are absent from the wire, while node transport send is the boundary after which cancellation cannot guarantee no side effect.

options.title: Deadline, cancel, and state
options.body: Add optional deadline and cancel-by-request-id support with explicit pending, effecting, and completed outcomes.

options.title: Deadline only
options.body: Propagate finite timeouts now while deferring explicit AbortSignal cancellation and indeterminate post-dispatch outcomes.

options.title: Pause for protocol design
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers specify the complete request-cancellation protocol separately.

recommendation.title: Deadline, cancel, and state
recommendation.body: Add optional deadline and cancel-by-request-id support with explicit pending, effecting, and completed outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly owns the node policy, post-cancel boundary, request frames, approval limits, and WebSocket dispatcher.
